purpose: Strictly bounded supplementary measurement to (1) measure actual FastBM25 Python heap and OS WorkingSet/PrivateUsage vs PRAGMA cache_size/mmap_size, (2) decompose FastBM25 vs scalar stage timings (postings_fetch vs mapping_and_scoring vs top_selection vs metadata vs guard) on the locked 8 exposed queries under matched warm cache state, (3) verify full-corpus unique_cases=True (limit=100) parity and metadata speedup on all 8 queries, and (4) verify standalone no-env CLI search and revalidate.

part_a_memory_and_pragma_audit.pass_1: tracemalloc enabled: measure Python heap current and peak bytes of FastBM25 preload (ids, ordinals, case_codes, cases int32, norm float64)
part_a_memory_and_pragma_audit.pass_2: tracemalloc disabled: measure Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo (WorkingSetSize, PeakWorkingSetSize, PrivateUsage) before open, after FastBM25 preload, after Q01 case search, after Q01 passage search (limit=4096), and after Q01 passage search (limit=100, unique_cases=True)

in_process: LexicalSession(ROOT) open (initialization_seconds, preload_seconds, single guard() latency)

per_query_channel_sequence: 1. Warmup postings scan for query terms on the shared SQLite connection so postings pages are in identical cache state
2. Timed FastBM25/LexicalSession search (limit=4096, unique_cases=False) with full stage breakdown (guard, postings_fetch, mapping_and_scoring, top_selection, metadata)
3. Timed stage-instrumented scalar reference (fetchmany=4096, Python float64 accumulation, sort[:4096]) sharing the same PRAGMAs and warm cache state
4. Timed FastBM25/LexicalSession search (limit=100, unique_cases=True) with full stage breakdown and exact parity check against independent rank_cases oracle over all positive hits
part_c_stage_decomposed_8_query_comparis.ab_order_rule: Alternate step 2 (vectorized_4096) and step 3 (scalar_4096) by query ordinal parity (even ordinal: vectorized then scalar; odd ordinal: scalar then vectorized) so exactly 4/8 queries run vectorized first and 4/8 run scalar first after warmup.
